watches.name: TABLE TELLURIUM
watches.description: Inspired by the success of the SpaceOne Tellurium wristwatch, the Table Tellurium brings the fascination of celestial mechanics to your desk in a refined and sculptural format. Originally developed exclusively for SpaceOne retailers, this unique object is now available to collectors and enthusiasts. Designed as a tribute to the Tellurium universe, it highlights the lunar cycle through an elegant astronomical display that captures the poetic relationship between Earth and Moon. Crafted from steel and brass, and featuring a deep aventurine dial reminiscent of a star-filled night sky, the Table Tellurium combines contemporary design with horological inspiration. Its compact proportions make it a striking decorative piece, equally suited for an office, library, or collector's display. More than a desk object, the Table Tellurium is a conversation piece that reflects SpaceOne's passion for innovation, astronomy, and unconventional timekeeping.

specsRaw.Specifications Material: Steel & Brass Dial: Aventurine Diameter: 110 mm Height: 50 mm Display: Moon Phase Indication Designed for: SpaceOne Tellurium Collectors & Astronomy Enthusiasts
